import React from 'react'
  import { MDXTag } from '@mdx-js/tag'
  import { Playground, PropsTable } from 'docz'
import { Block, Pane, Box, Card } from './src'
import { Header, Paragraph } from '../typography';
import { Icon } from '../icon';
import { Button } from '../button';

const layoutProps = {
  
};
export default class MDXContent extends React.Component {
  constructor(props) {
    super(props)
    this.layout = null
  }
  render() {
    const { components, ...props } = this.props

    return <MDXTag
             name="wrapper"
             
             components={components}>
<MDXTag name="h1" components={components} props={{"id":"layout"}}>{`Layout`}</MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="h2" components={components} props={{"id":"pane"}}>{`Pane`}</MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="p" components={components}>{`The Pane component maps almost directly to the Box component. This means you can pass everything to Pane that you can pass to Box.`}</MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="p" components={components}>{`The primary purpose of a pane is to group layouts`}</MDXTag>
<Playground __codesandbox={`undefined`} __position={0} __code={'<Pane>Hello World\n</Playground>'} __scope={{props: this ? this.props : props,Block,Pane,Box,Card,Header,Paragraph,Icon,Button}}>
  <Pane>Hello World</Pane>
</Playground>
<MDXTag name="h2" components={components} props={{"id":"block"}}>{`Block`}</MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="p" components={components}>{`Shows or hides content`}</MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="h2" components={components} props={{"id":"usage"}}>{`Usage`}</MDXTag>
<Playground __codesandbox={`undefined`} __position={1} __code={'<Block showAt=\"md\">I will be shown from medium width and up\n  <Block hideAt=\"md\">I will hidden from medium width down</Block>\n</Playground>'} __scope={{props: this ? this.props : props,Block,Pane,Box,Card,Header,Paragraph,Icon,Button}}>
  <Block showAt="md">I will be shown from medium width and up</Block>
  <Block hideAt="md">I will hidden from medium width down</Block>
</Playground>
<MDXTag name="h2" components={components} props={{"id":"card"}}>{`Card`}</MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="p" components={components}>{`The Card component just wraps the Pane component and provides a default `}<MDXTag name="inlineCode" components={components} parentName="p">{`elevation`}</MDXTag>{` & `}<MDXTag name="inlineCode" components={components} parentName="p">{`border-radius`}</MDXTag>{`.`}</MDXTag>
<Playground __codesandbox={`undefined`} __position={2} __code={'<Card>\n    <Pane p={10}>Hello, World\n  </Card>\n</Playground>'} __scope={{props: this ? this.props : props,Block,Pane,Box,Card,Header,Paragraph,Icon,Button}}>
  <Card><Pane p={10}>Hello, World</Pane></Card>
</Playground>
<MDXTag name="h1" components={components} props={{"id":"overrides"}}>{`Overrides`}</MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="p" components={components}>{`Any layout component can accept a background override, this is really only useful for very subtle background alterations`}</MDXTag>
<Playground __codesandbox={`undefined`} __position={3} __code={'<Card variant=\"c\" p={20}>\n    <Pane variant=\"a\" backgroundColor=\"normal\" p={10}>\n      Hello, World\n    \n  </Card>\n</Playground>'} __scope={{props: this ? this.props : props,Block,Pane,Box,Card,Header,Paragraph,Icon,Button}}>
  <Card variant="c" p={20}><Pane variant="a" backgroundColor="normal" p={10}>Hello, World</Pane></Card>
</Playground>
<MDXTag name="h3" components={components} props={{"id":"elevation"}}>{`Elevation`}</MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="p" components={components}>{`Panes and Cards have a elevation property to give the component a box shadow and visually elevate it from the page.`}</MDXTag>
           </MDXTag>
  }
}
